UPDATE: A CSS-only change can break visual snapshot tests. Snapshot tests compare rendered output against baselines, so CSS affects the pixels they inspect.

To narrow it down: does the CI output show *which* snapshots failed, and do they match components you actually changed? If the failures are in unrelated UI, then infra. If they're in what your CSS touched, it's yours.

What would settle it fastest: run the visual tests locally with your CSS changes and see if they fail the same way.

grade.note: Acknowledges CSS could cause snapshot failures and proposes concrete checks (which snapshots failed, local repro) rather than asserting a definitive cause.
